account.title: Ama-eSIM ami
account.description: Faka, hlola idatha esele futhi ugcwalise ama-eSIM akho.
account.noUsageYet: Ukusetshenziswa kuvela uma i-eSIM isisetshenzisiwe. Vuselela ukuze uhlole.
account.unlimitedUsage: Iphakheji elingenamkhawulo — alikho inani eliphelele lokubala.
account.installHint: Faka ngaphambi kokuhamba ngesikhathi usene-Wi-Fi. Skena ikhodi ye-QR kwesinye isikrini, noma uthinte isixhumanisi efonini ezosebenzisa i-eSIM.
account.alreadyInstalled: Le eSIM ibonakala sengathi isifakiwe. Ikhodi ye-QR ngokuvamile ingafakwa kanye kuphela.

browse.title: Izindawo ze-eSIM
browse.description: Khetha lapho uya khona. Amaphakheji ezwe elilodwa, isifunda sonke, noma umhlaba wonke.
browse.seoDescription: Amaphakheji edatha e-eSIM akhokhelwa kusengaphambili amazwe, izifunda nomhlaba wonke. Faka emizuzwini embalwa.

page.title: I-eSIM ye-{name}
page.seoDescription: Amaphakheji edatha e-eSIM akhokhelwa kusengaphambili e-{name}. Faka emizuzwini embalwa, azikho izindleko ze-roaming.
page.seoDescriptionPrice: Amaphakheji edatha e-eSIM akhokhelwa kusengaphambili e-{name} kusukela ku-{price}. Faka emizuzwini embalwa, azikho izindleko ze-roaming. {store}
page.subtitleLocal: Idatha ekhokhelwa kusengaphambili yohambo lwakho — faka ngaphambi kokundiza.

how.installText: Sikuthumelela ikhodi ye-QR nge-imeyili ngokushesha. Yiskene, noma uthinte isixhumanisi sokuthinta kanye.
how.landText: Shintshela idatha ku-eSIM uma ufika. Azikho izikweletu ze-roaming.

faq.compatibleA: Ifoni yakho kumele isekele i-eSIM futhi ingavalelwe kunethiwekhi eyodwa. Ama-iPhone amaningi kusukela ku-XS, i-Google Pixel 3 nangaphezulu, namamodeli akamuva e-Samsung Galaxy ayasekela.
faq.whenA: Yifake ngaphambi kokuhamba ngesikhathi usene-Wi-Fi. Iphakheji liqala uma lixhuma okokuqala lapho uya khona, ngaphandle uma iphakheji lisho okunye.
faq.numberA: Yebo. I-eSIM ingeyedatha; i-SIM yakho evamile ihlala efonini yezingcingo nama-SMS.
faq.topupA: Amaphakheji amakwe ngokuthi "Gcwalisa leli phakheji" noma "Engeza amaphakheji" angagcwaliswa kuma-eSIM ami.

selector.none: Awekho amaphakheji adayiswayo kule ndawo okwamanje.
selector.startHint: Iphakheji liqala ngalolu suku (UTC), hhayi uma ulifaka.

devices.notFound: Leyo modeli ayikho ohlwini lwethu. Ingase isekele i-eSIM — hlola izilungiselelo zefoni yakho.
devices.howToCheck: Ukuze uqiniseke: ku-iPhone vula Izilungiselelo → Okujwayelekile → Mayelana futhi ubheke "I-SIM yedijithali" noma "I-SIM etholakalayo"; ku-Android shayela *#06# ubheke i-EID. Ifoni kumele futhi ingavalelwe kunethiwekhi eyodwa.

details.coverageNote: Leli phakheji lisebenza kuphela emazweni nasezifundeni elizihlanganisayo. Sicela uhlole ngaphambi kokuthenga.
details.title: Mayelana nale eSIM
details.dataDailyThrottled: Isabelo sansuku zonke, bese ijubane liyehla
details.dataDailyCutoff: Isabelo sansuku zonke, esivuselelwa nsuku zonke
details.startConnection: Iphakheji liqala uma i-eSIM ixhuma okokuqala lapho uya khona.
details.topupNone: Akukho ukugcwalisa: thenga elinye iphakheji uma udinga okwengeziwe.

topup.hint: Isiphela? Engeza idatha kule eSIM — akukho okusha okufakwayo.
topup.title: Gcwalisa i-eSIM yakho
topup.stack: Ukugcwalisa kungezwa ephakheji lakho lamanje: idatha eyengeziwe, kwamanye amaphakheji nezinsuku ezengeziwe.
topup.addon: Ukugcwalisa kuyiphakheji elizimele: idatha nezinsuku zakho kuqala eceleni kwephakheji lakho lamanje.
topup.supplierDown: Asikwazanga ukulayisha ukugcwalisa kwale eSIM okwamanje. Sicela uzame futhi emizuzwini embalwa.
topup.note: Akukho okusha okufakwayo: ukugcwalisa kuya kule eSIM. Khokha ngebhalansi yakho noma nganoma iyiphi indlela yokukhokha lapho ukhokha.

refusal.expired: Leli phakheji liphelelwe yisikhathi futhi alisakwazi ukugcwaliswa. Esikhundleni salokho thenga i-eSIM entsha.
refusal.used_up: Idatha yaleli phakheji iphelile futhi alisakwazi ukugcwaliswa. Esikhundleni salokho thenga i-eSIM entsha.
refusal.profile_expired: Le eSIM ayisasebenzi. Esikhundleni salokho thenga i-eSIM entsha.

wallet.title: Ibhalansi
wallet.unavailable: Ukwengeza imali ebhalansini yakho akutholakali okwamanje.
wallet.note: Ibhalansi yakho isetshenziswa lapho ukhokha ama-eSIM nokugcwalisa. Imali eyengezwe ebhalansini yakho ayibuyiselwa ekhadini lakho.
wallet.covers: Ibhalansi yakho ikhokhela leli oda — akukho okunye okukhokhwayo.
wallet.parked: Izinto ezingu-{count} enqoleni yakho zibekwa eceleni ngenkathi wengeza imali. Zibuyela enqoleni uma isikhokhiwe, noma uma ubuyela ekukhokheni.
wallet.parkNote: Ukwengeza imali kukhokhwa ngokwahlukile. Izinto ezisenqoleni zibekwa eceleni okwamanje bese zibuyela enqoleni ngemuva kwalokho.

referral.title: Mema abangane
referral.teaser: Mema abangane uthole umklomelo kuma-oda abo
referral.friendGets: Umngane wakho uthola isaphulelo esingu-{discount} ku-oda lakhe lokuqala.

kyc.title: Ukuqinisekiswa komazisi
kyc.why: Amanethiwekhi amanye amazwe adinga ukwazi ukuthi ubani osebenzisa i-eSIM. Qinisekisa kanye, futhi wonke ama-eSIM akudingayo angathengwa.
kyc.rejected: Akuphumelelanga: {reason}. Sicela uthumele imininingwane yakho futhi.
kyc.privacy: Imibhalo yakho igcinwa ngasese futhi ibonwa kuphela abasebenzi bethu abayihlolayo.

pay.title: Qedela inkokhelo yakho
pay.scan: Skena ikhodi nge-app yesikhwama sakho ukuze ukhokhe.
pay.closedNote: Uma ukhokhile, inkokhelo izobuyiselwa. Sicela ukhokhe futhi.
pay.none: Ayikho indlela yokukhokha etholakalayo okwamanje. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva.
pay.note: I-oda lakho lidalwa ngokushesha uma inkokhelo iqinisekisiwe. Ungakhokheli i-oda elifanayo kabili.

cancel.confirmBalance: Iyayeka ukusebenza ngokushesha futhi ayikwazi ukufakwa. U-{refund} ubuyela ebhalansini yakho (kugcinwa imali yesevisi engu-{fee}).
cancel.confirmOriginal: Iyayeka ukusebenza ngokushesha futhi ayikwazi ukufakwa. U-{refund} ubuyiselwa endleleni yakho yokukhokha (kugcinwa imali yesevisi engu-{fee}).
cancel.supplierRefused: Inethiwekhi ayikwamukelanga ukukhansela. Sicela uxhumane nathi.

coverage.operatorUnknown: Umhlinzeki akalunikezanga lolu lwazi. Uma isifakiwe, i-eSIM ixhuma ngokuzenzakalelayo kumhlinzeki wenethiwekhi wendawo.

campaign.howTo: Faka ikhodi {code} lapho ukhokha. Isebenza kuma-eSIM alezi zindawo kuze kuphele okunikezwayo.

order.title: Ama-eSIM akuleli oda
order.installHint: Vula i-eSIM ukuze ubone ikhodi yayo ye-QR nezinyathelo zokufaka. Imininingwane efanayo ithunyelwe kuwe nge-imeyili.

plans.title: Khetha iphakheji
plans.ruleStackData: Ukugcwalisa kwengeza idatha kuleli phakheji; usuku lokuphela luhlala lunjalo.
plans.ruleStackBoth: Ukugcwalisa kwengeza idatha futhi kunweba isikhathi saleli phakheji.
plans.ruleAddon: Ukugcwalisa ngakunye kuyiphakheji elihlukile elinedatha nesikhathi salo.
plans.ruleBeforeExpiry: Gcwalisa ngaphambi kokuthi iphakheji liphelelwe yisikhathi; uma seliphelelwe, i-eSIM ayisakwazi ukugcwaliswa.
plans.ruleAnyTime: Ungagcwalisa noma nini, ngisho nangemva kokuphela kwephakheji lamanje.
plans.ruleRetention: Uma lingekho iphakheji elisebenzayo izinsuku ezingu-{days}, inethiwekhi isusa i-eSIM.
plans.ruleWhere: Gcwalisa kuma-eSIM ami, ku-eSIM efanayo — akukho ukufaka okusha.
plans.ruleNone: Leli phakheji alikwazi ukugcwaliswa. Uma udinga okwengeziwe, thenga elinye iphakheji.

numbers.seoDescription: Khetha inombolo yeselula ku-eSIM: izingcingo, ama-SMS nedatha, nesikweletu nephakheji ledatha uma uthanda.
numbers.title: Izinombolo zefoni
numbers.description: Inombolo yangempela yeselula ku-eSIM, yezingcingo, ama-SMS nedatha. Khetha inombolo, wengeze isikweletu nephakheji ledatha uma uthanda.
numbers.none: Azikho izinombolo ezifanayo. Zama enye ikhodi yezwe noma amadijithi ambalwa.
numbers.signIn: Ngena ukuze uthenge inombolo; uzobuyela lapha.
numbers.holdHint: Inombolo igcinelwa wena imizuzu engu-10 uma uqala ukukhokha. Imininingwane yokufaka izoba ku-akhawunti yakho ngemuva kokukhokha.
numbers.rechargeAmounts: Amanani aphelele kusukela ku-{min} kuya ku-{max}.
numbers.creditUnpriced: Isikweletu asikwazi ukubekelwa intengo okwamanje; sicela uzame futhi kamuva.
numbers.notReady: Izinombolo azikwazi ukuthengwa okwamanje. Sicela uzame futhi kamuva noma uxhumane nathi.
numbers.chargedAtRate: Ngenani lokushintshaniswa lamanje {amount} = {price}, ngakho uzokhokha {price} lapho ukhokha.

number.pending: Kungezwa kunombolo: {items}. Lokhu ngokuvamile kuthatha imizuzu embalwa.
number.noCard: Ibhalansi ivela uma inethiwekhi iphendula. Vuselela ukuze uhlole.
number.pinHint: Gcina i-PIN ne-PUK kuyimfihlo: zivula inombolo uma ifoni izicela.
number.validHint: Inombolo ihlala ingeyakho unyaka owodwa ngemuva kokusetshenziswa kokugcina. Yisebenzise ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze uyigcine.
number.topupHint: Kukhokhwa lapho ukhokha, bese kungezwa ku-{number} emizuzwini embalwa.
number.cancelPacketHint: Iphakheji liyama manje. Idatha esele kulo ayibuyiselwa.
number.smsHint: I-SMS eya ku-{number}, ukuhlola ukuthi iyayithola imilayezo.
number.transferHint: Idlulisa ikhredithi isuka ku-{number} iye kwenye yezinombolo zakho.
number.transferToHint: Noma iyiphi inombolo ye-TopConnect, nekhodi yezwe.

copy.heroSubtitle: Ama-eSIM okuhamba akhokhelwa kusengaphambili. Afakwa ngemizuzu, awekho ama-bill e-roaming.
copy.numbersSubtitle: Inombolo yeselula yangempela ku-eSIM: izingcingo, ama-SMS nedatha.
copy.numbersSubtitleShort: Inombolo yeselula yangempela ku-eSIM: ama-SMS nedatha.
copy.howPickText: Khetha lapho uya khona, izinsuku nedatha. Khokha ngokuphepha.
copy.howScanText: Sikuthumelela ikhodi ye-QR nge-imeyili ngokushesha. Yiskene, noma uthephe isixhumanisi sokuthepha kanye.
copy.howLandText: Vula i-eSIM uma ufika. Awekho ama-bill e-roaming.
copy.installOpenIos: Vula i-imeyili ye-eSIM kwesinye isikrini, noma uthephe isixhumanisi se-iPhone sokuthepha kanye kulolu cingo.
copy.installOpenAndroid: Vula i-imeyili ye-eSIM kwesinye isikrini, noma uthephe isixhumanisi se-Android sokuthepha kanye kulolu cingo.
copy.installAddIos: Izilungiselelo → Cellular → Engeza i-eSIM → Sebenzisa ikhodi ye-QR, bese uskena ikhodi.
copy.installAddAndroid: Izilungiselelo → Inethiwekhi ne-inthanethi → Ama-SIM → Engeza i-eSIM (noma Landa i-SIM) bese uskena ikhodi.
copy.installNameText: Yibize ngokuthi "Uhambo" bese ugcina ulayini wakho ojwayelekile wezingcingo nama-SMS.
copy.installAbroadIos: Uma ufika, khetha i-eSIM yokuhamba yedatha yeselula bese uvula i-Data Roaming yayo.
copy.installAbroadAndroid: Uma ufika, khetha i-eSIM yokuhamba yedatha yeselula bese uvula i-roaming yayo.
copy.devicesSubtitle: Thola ucingo lwakho uhlole ngaphambi kokuthenga.
copy.deviceChinaIphone: Ama-iPhone amaningi athengiswa e-China, eHong Kong naseMacao asebenzisa ama-SIM amabili angokoqobo esikhundleni se-eSIM.
copy.deviceSamsung: Amamodeli athengiswa e-China, eHong Kong, eTaiwan namanye amamodeli ezinkampani zaseMelika awayisekeli i-eSIM.
copy.devicePixel3: Hhayi amamodeli athengiswa e-Australia, eTaiwan noma eJapan, futhi hhayi amamodeli aseMelika athengwe ezinkampanini okungezona i-Sprint noma i-Google Fi.
copy.faqWhatA: Ikhadi le-SIM elakhelwe ngaphakathi ocingweni lwakho. Ulanda uhlelo lwedatha ngokuskena ikhodi ye-QR — akukho okufanele kuthunyelwe, akukho okufanele kushintshwe.
copy.faqStartA: Izinhlelo eziningi ziqala lapho i-eSIM ixhumeka okokuqala lapho uya khona, ngakho ungayifaka ezinsukwini ngaphambi kohambo.
copy.faqNumberA: Yebo. I-eSIM ingeyedatha kuphela; i-SIM yakho ejwayelekile ihlala ivuliwe ezingcingweni nama-SMS.
copy.faqDataA: Izinhlelo ezivumelayo zingagcwaliswa ku-eSIM zami, noma uthenge olunye uhlelo lohambo olufanayo.

esim.confirmActivate: Vula amaphakheji angu-{count}? Azobekelwa intengo futhi angashicilelwa.
esim.confirmDisable: Vala amaphakheji angu-{count}? Izinhlobo zawo zizophuma esitolo lapho kushicilelwa ngokulandelayo.
esim.confirmPublish: Shicilela izindawo zamaphakheji angu-{count}? Imikhiqizo emisha idalwa njengezinhlaka.
esim.priceSaved: Intengo ilondoloziwe. Shicilela indawo ukuze ubuyekeze isitolo.
esim.searchPlans: Sesha igama, indawo noma i-ID yephakheji yomhlinzeki
esim.noPlans: Awekho amaphakheji afanayo. Vumelanisa umhlinzeki, noma ushintshe izihlungi.
esim.previewSummary: Izintengo ezingu-{changed} kwezingu-{considered} ziyashintsha: {up} ziyakhuphuka, {down} ziyehla ({avg}% ngokwesilinganiso); {active} kuzo zivuliwe.
esim.previewNew: Amaphakheji angu-{count} athola intengo yawo yokuqala.
esim.missingRates: Alikho izinga lokushintshaniswa kwe-{currencies}: lawo maphakheji agcina intengo yawo.
esim.repriced: Kulondoloziwe. Amaphakheji angu-{count} abekelwe intengo kabusha; shicilela izindawo ukuze ubuyekeze isitolo.
esim.pricingHint: Intengo yokuthengisa = izindleko × izinga lokushintshaniswa × (1 + isivikelo) × (1 + inzuzo eyengeziwe), ingalokothi ibe ngaphansi kwenzuzo encane, ihlanganiswe phezulu. Umthetho osebenzayo ocacile kakhulu ubeka inzuzo eyengeziwe.
esim.minMarginHint: Yentengo yokuthengisa; ivikela enzuzweni eyengeziwe ephansi.
esim.fxBufferHint: Kungezwa ezindlekweni eziguquliwe ngenxa yokuguquguquka kwezinga.
esim.threshold: Beka intengo kabusha uma izinga lishintsha ngaphezu kuka-%
esim.noRules: Ayikho imithetho: wonke amaphakheji asebenzisa inzuzo eyengeziwe ezenzakalelayo.
esim.fxHint: Amazinga e-European Central Bank, avuselelwa nsuku zonke; akamuva {date}. Izinga elibekwe ngesandla liyasebenza kuze kube lisusiwe.
esim.fxRefreshed: Amazinga ka-{date} alayishiwe; amaphakheji angu-{count} abekelwe intengo kabusha.
esim.ruleHint: Shiya inkambu ku-"noma yikuphi" ukuze ifane nakho konke. Umthetho obiza izinkambu eziningi uyawina; uma zilingana, onokubaluleka okuphezulu.
esim.syncStarted: Ukuvumelanisa kuqalile. Kungathatha imizuzu embalwa; vuselela ukuze ubone inqubekela phambili.
esim.providersHint: Abahlinzeki be-eSIM lapho kuthengwa khona amaphakheji. Umhlinzeki ovaliwe akavumelaniswa futhi akathengiswa.
esim.confirmCancel: Khansela le eSIM kumhlinzeki? Iyayeka ukusebenza; buyisela umthengi imali ngokwahlukile uma kudingeka.
esim.notResent: I-imeyili ayikwazanga ukuthunyelwa; hlola ikheli le-imeyili le-oda nezilungiselelo ze-imeyili
esim.redacted: Okhiye, amaphasiwedi namakhodi okwenza isebenze kuyasuswa ngaphambi kokuba ucingo lugcinwe.
esim.problemsHint: Ama-eSIM angakwazanga ukukhishwa, noma athatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. I-eSIM ehlulekile yomthengi obhalisile ibuyiselwa njengesikweletu sesitolo ngokuzenzakalela; eyesivakashi idinga ukubuyiselwa ngesandla.
esim.mayStillDeliver: Umhlinzeki kungenzeka useyikhiphile le eSIM. Hlola iphothali yakhe ngaphambi kokuzama omunye umhlinzeki noma ukubuyisela imali.
esim.confirmFail: Yeka ukuzama ubuyisele umthengi imali (isikweletu sesitolo; isivakashi sidinga ukubuyiselwa ngesandla)?
esim.bindHint: I-eSIM ifundwa kumhlinzeki okhethiwe nge-ICCID yayo, ibhalwe ku-oda futhi ithunyelwe kumthengi nge-imeyili.
esim.confirmPlansOff: Vala wonke amaphakheji ezindawo ezingu-{count}? Azophuma esitolo lapho kushicilelwa ngokulandelayo.
esim.confirmPublishDestinations: Shicilela izindawo ezingu-{count}? Imikhiqizo emisha idalwa njengezinhlaka.
esim.devicesBuiltIn: Isitolo sibonisa uhlu olwakhelwe ngaphakathi lwamamodeli angu-{count}. Lungenise ukuze ulushintshe, noma wengeze amamodeli ngamunye.
esim.devicesHint: Amafoni namathebulethi ukuhlola idivayisi esitolo okwaziyo.
esim.jobFulfilment: Ukuzama futhi, ukubuza abahlinzeki nama-oda akhokhiwe angakaze afakwe olayini. Njalo ngomzuzu.
esim.jobCatalog: Ivumelanisa amaphakheji awo wonke umhlinzeki osebenzayo. Njalo emahoreni angu-6.
esim.jobFx: Ilayisha amazinga okushintshaniswa osuku futhi ibeke kabusha izintengo zamaphakheji uhlobo lwawo lwemali olushintshile. Nsuku zonke.
esim.jobStarted: Kuqalile. Vuselela kungekudala ukuze ubone umphumela.
esim.jobsHint: Asebenza uma isihleli sishayela ikheli lawo nge-CRON_SECRET: ku-Vercel kusuka ku-vercel.json, kuseva yakho kusuka ku-cron yayo.
esim.jobsStale: Umsebenzi othile awusebenzanga ngesikhathi. Ngaphandle komsebenzi wokukhishwa, ukuzama futhi nabahlinzeki abahamba kancane abaphinde bathathwe.
esim.mappingHint: Iphakheji lokuqala lohlobo ngalunye liyinhloko: uhlobo ludayiswa ngentengo yalo futhi luthengwa kulo kuqala; amanye azanywa ngokulandelana uma lenqaba. Elishibhile liholayo ngaphandle uma uphina elilodwa.
esim.notPublishedYet: Akukashicilelwa: vula amaphakheji bese ushicilela indawo emtatsheni wamaphakheji.
esim.helpCreated: Amakhasi osizo angu-{count} adaliwe futhi ashicilelwe
esim.helpPagesHint: Amakhasi asenziwe ngamabhulokhi e-eSIM; wahlele kumakhi wamakhasi futhi uwaxhumanise kumamenyu akho.
esim.topupsHint: Ukugcwalisa idatha abathengi abakuthengele ama-eSIM abo. Ukugcwalisa okuhlulekile kubuyiselwa esikweletwini sesitolo somthengi ngokuzenzakalela.
esim.topupMayHaveHappened: Umhlinzeki kungenzeka usekwenzile lokhu kugcwalisa. Hlola iphothali yakhe ngaphambi kokubuyisela imali; ukuzama futhi kuphephile.
esim.confirmFailTopup: Yeka ukuzama ubuyisele esikweletwini sesitolo somthengi?
esim.jobUsage: Ihlola ukusetshenziswa kwama-eSIM asebenzayo kubahlinzeki bawo, ithumela izikhumbuzo kubathengi futhi ikhokhe imiklomelo yokudlulisela efanele. Njalo emizuzwini engu-30.
esim.remindersHint: Zithunyelwa umsebenzi wokusetshenziswa nge-imeyili, nase-akhawuntini kubathengi ababhalisile: uma i-eSIM ixhuma, uma idatha isiphela (nesixhumanisi sokugcwalisa), ngaphambi kokuthi iphakheji liphele nangaphambi kosuku lokugcina lokufaka. Ngasinye sithunyelwa kanye.
esim.walletHint: Abathengi bengeza imali ebhalansini yabo kuma-eSIM ami futhi bayikhokhele lapho bekhokha. Inani libhalwa njengebhalansi abayikweletwayo, imali yesevisi njengengeniso; ibhalansi eyengezwe ngale ndlela ayibuyiselwa njengemali.
esim.referralsHint: Abathengi babelana nge-/esim/invite/[code]. Umngane ovula i-akhawunti ngayo ubazuzisa umklomelo nge-oda ngalinye elilethiwe, olwengezwa ebhalansini yabo ngemuva kwesikhathi sokulinda — kubhalwe njengokukhangisa. Abathengi abangu-{count} bajoyine ngokudluliselwa.
esim.referralCouponHint: Ikhuphoni elisetshenziswa kanye le-akhawunti yakhe kuphela, elenziwa uma ebhalisa ngesixhumanisi.
esim.kycHint: Abathengi baqinisekisa umazisi wabo kanye, kuma-eSIM ami. Iphakheji elikudingayo lingathengwa kuphela umthengi oqinisekisiwe, hhayi isivakashi.
esim.kycFormHint: Ukushicilela kwenza inguqulo entsha; okuthunyelwe kugcina inguqulo okuyiphendulile.
esim.kycRulesHint: Iphakheji lidinga i-KYC uma libekwe kanjalo emtatsheni wamaphakheji; uma kungenjalo, uma lihlanganisa izwe elisohlwini; uma kungenjalo, uma umhlinzeki walo esho kanjalo. Kubekwe emtatsheni wamaphakheji: {required} ayayidinga, {notRequired} awayidingi.
esim.confirmKyc: Shintsha ukuthi amaphakheji angu-{count} adinga ukuqinisekiswa komazisi yini?
esim.kycNoStorage: Isitoreji samafayela asisethiwe (Izilungiselelo → Isitoreji), ngakho abathengi abakwazi ukulayisha imibhalo. Sisethe, noma ushicilele ifomu elingenayo imibuzo yamafayela.
esim.paymentsHint: Izinkokhelo ezenziwe ngamasango okukhokha e-eSIM. I-oda lenziwa uma isango liqinisekisa inkokhelo; imbuyiselo yalezi zinkokhelo yenziwa ngesandla esangweni.
esim.payStripeHint: KuDashboard yeStripe, engeza le URL yesaziso njenge-webhook endpoint ye-checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, checkout.session.async_payment_failed, checkout.session.expired, bese unamathisela imfihlo yayo yokusayina (whsec_…) ku-webhookSecret. I-methods ayiphoqelekile, isb. alipay,wechat_pay; uma ishiywe ingenalutho, iStripe ibonisa izindlela zokukhokha ezivuliwe kuDashboard yayo.
esim.checkoutDisplayHint: Uhlelo amakhasimende azibona ngalo izindlela zokukhokha, eyodwa ekhethiwe uma kuvulwa indawo yokukhokha, kanye nesithonjana sendlela ngayinye. Kuboniswa kuphela izindlela ezivuliwe. Ibhalansi ye-akhawunti ihlala iza kuqala uma yanele ukukhokhela i-oda.
esim.esimGatewaysHint: Amasango axhunywe yimojula ye-eSIM. Ngalinye elivuliwe nelisethiwe liyindlela yokukhokha yalo endaweni yokukhokha; i-oda lenziwa uma isango liqinisekisa inkokhelo, futhi imbuyiselo yenziwa ngesandla esangweni.
esim.paymentsMoved: Amasango, uhlelo lwawo nezithonjana endaweni yokukhokha, kanye nezimali zokukhokha kusethwa ku-Izilungiselelo → Inkokhelo.
esim.payConfirmRefunded: Bhala ukuthi u-{amount} ubuyiselwe kumthengi nge-{method}?
esim.migConfirm: Ngenisa manje abathengi, amabhalansi, ukudluliselwa nama-eSIM asebenzayo esitolo esidala? Abathengi abathunyelelwa ama-imeyili. Ukuphinda ukuqalise kamuva kwengeza okusha kuphela.
esim.migStarted: Kuqalile; leli khasi lizobuyekezwa uma sekuqediwe
esim.migHint: Iletha abathengi (namaphasiwedi abo amadala), amabhalansi, ukudluliselwa nama-eSIM asebenzayo esitolo esidala. Ama-oda amadala awangeniswa. Vumelanisa ikhathalogi yawo wonke umhlinzeki kuqala: i-eSIM iphakheji layo elingakabi lapha iyashiywa, futhi ukungenisa okulandelayo kuyayithatha.
esim.migNoSource: Akulungiselelwe — beka i-LEGACY_MYSQL_HOST, LEGACY_MYSQL_DATABASE, LEGACY_MYSQL_USER ne-LEGACY_MYSQL_PASSWORD ku-.env bese uqala kabusha.
esim.cancelHint: Umthengi angakhansela i-eSIM engakafakwa, ephakheji umhlinzeki walo alimake njengelibuyiselwayo, uma umhlinzeki ekhansela nge-API yakhe. Umhlinzeki ubuzwa kuqala; umthengi ubuyiselwa imali kuphela uma evuma.
esim.reportsHint: Ukuthengiswa kwe-eSIM nenzuzo ephelele ngezintengo nezindleko zomhlinzeki ezabhalwa lapho i-eSIM ngayinye ithengwa. Amanani nge-USD; izinsuku nge-UTC.
esim.reportCostUnknown: Ukuthengisa okungu-{count} akunazo izindleko zomhlinzeki nge-USD (lalingekho izinga lokushintshaniswa ngaleso sikhathi) futhi akufakwanga enzuzweni.
esim.reportNoSnapshot: Ama-eSIM angu-{count} akhishwe kulesi sikhathi athengwa ngaphambi kokuthi kugcinwe amarekhodi okuthengisa, noma angeniswa, futhi awabalwa.
esim.reportVoided: Ama-eSIM angu-{count} ({amount}) akhanselwa noma abuyiselwa imali futhi awabalwa njengokuthengisa.
esim.confirmApprove: Thenga wonke ama-eSIM ale oda manje?
esim.confirmReject: Ungathengi lutho kuleli oda? Bese ubuyisela inkokhelo ku-Storify (Ama-oda → Buyisela) lapho ivela khona.
esim.riskHint: Bamba ama-eSIM e-oda elikhokhiwe ukuze abuyekezwe umuntu ngaphambi kokuthenga lutho kumhlinzeki. Ama-oda abanjiwe avela ngaphansi kwe-eSIM → Izinkinga, ukuze avunywe noma enqatshwe. U-0 uvala umthetho.
esim.campaignsHint: Umkhankaso yikhasi elinesibhengezo nekhodi yekhuphoni yezindawo ezikhethiwe, ezinsukwini zawo. Ikhodi iyikhuphoni ye-Storify ehambisana nomkhankaso, futhi isebenza kuphela kuma-eSIM alezo zindawo.
esim.campaignConfirmDelete: Susa lo mkhankaso? Ikhasi lawo liyasuka, futhi ikhodi yekhuphoni iyayeka ukusebenza.
esim.campaignActive: Kuyasebenza: ikhasi nekhodi kusebenza phakathi kwezinsuku
esim.feesHint: Kungezwa ku-oda ngokwendlela ekhokhwa ngayo: inani elinqunyiwe kanye nephesenti lempahla, kuboniswa lapho kukhokhwa njengomugqa othi "Imali yesevisi yenkokhelo" futhi kubuyiselwa kanye ne-oda. Ukukhokha ngebhalansi, nokugcwalisa isikhwama, akunayo imali yesevisi.
esim.balanceHoldHint: Bonke abahlinzeki bale eSIM baphelelwe yibhalansi. Gcwalisa oyedwa: kuzanywa futhi njalo emizuzwini engu-10 (noma uzame manje) kuze kube ngu-{until}, bese kubuyiselwa imali.
esim.navHint: Ibha engezansi esitolo kumafoni namathebulethi. Vula noma uvale amathebhu, uwahlele futhi uwaqambe kabusha. Kubonakala angu-{max} kuphela; Imenyu ihlala njalo, ngoba iyona kuphela indlela eya kumenyu eseceleni efonini.
esim.navDefault: Isitolo sibonisa ibha yaso. Londoloza ukuze usebenzise esethwe lapha.
esim.menuHint: Imenyu evulwa yithebhu ye-Imenyu kumafoni namathebulethi. Fihla izingxenye ongazidingi, futhi ubhale amakhasi e-eSIM noma izixhumanisi zakho ngaphansi kweKhaya. Izixhumanisi eziphakathi zisavela kumenyu yesihloko ngaphansi kwe-Isitolo se-inthanethi → Ukuzulazula.
esim.numbersOnlySupplier: Amakhadi ezinombolo (isitoko singeniswe ngaphansi kwe-eSIM → Izinombolo)
esim.numbersHint: Amakhadi ezinombolo e-TopConnect asesitokweni. {available} akhululekile · {reserved} abanjiwe · {sold} adayisiwe · {retired} akasadayiswa
esim.searchNumbers: Inombolo, i-ICCID, iqoqo noma i-imeyili yekhasimende
esim.importNumbersHint: Ikhadi elilodwa emugqeni ngamunye, njengoba i-TopConnect iwathumela: MSISDN ICCID LPA PIN1 PUK1 PIN2 PUK2, ahlukaniswe ngezikhala, amathebhu noma okhefana. Umugqa ungaphela ngentengo yawo nenani elengeziwe. Izinombolo esezisesitokweni ziyeqiwa.
esim.dialCodeHint: Shiya ikhodi yezwe ingenalutho uma yonke inombolo isivele iqala ngekhodi yayo.
esim.numberPackagesHint: Amaphakethe edatha umnikazi wenombolo angawathenga. Izindleko yintengo ye-TopConnect, efakwa ekhadini ngaphambi kokuvulwa kwephakethe; intengo ilandela imithetho yamanani ngaphandle uma uyibeka.
esim.loadPacketsNeeds: Kudinga umhlinzeki we-TopConnect avuliwe nenombolo esesitokweni
esim.noPackets: Awekho amaphakheji edatha okwamanje. Walayishe ku-TopConnect noma wengeze elilodwa ngesandla.
esim.packetIdHint: I-ID yephakethe yikhodi yephakethe ye-TopConnect, leyo evulwa ekhadini.
esim.packetCountriesHint: Amazwe lapho lisebenza khona (amakhodi, isb. FR, DE, IT)
esim.numberProductProblem: Izinombolo azikakwazi ukuthengwa: umkhiqizo wesitolo ezidayiswa ngawo awukwazanga ukwenziwa ({reason}).
esim.numberSettingsHint: Yonke inombolo idayiswa nokushaja kokuqala. Ukushaja okuncane kakhulu kusebenza kokuqala nakwalandelayo: amanani aphelele ngohlobo lwemali lwekhadi ({currency}).
esim.providerCurrencyHint: Izindleko ezingenalo uhlobo lwazo lwemali zifundwa ngalolu hlobo lwemali futhi ziguqulelwe ku-USD ngezinga lokushintshaniswa kanye nesivikelo.
esim.providerCurrencyInvalid: Faka ikhodi yohlobo lwemali enezinhlamvu ezintathu, njenge-USD noma i-EUR
esim.packetLoadHint: I-TopConnect ibala amaphakheji enethiwekhi ikhadi elikuyo. Ikhadi elingasetshenziswa alikho kunoma iyiphi inethiwekhi, ngakho faka ikhodi yenethiwekhi (MCC+MNC) yenethiwekhi amaphakheji ayo, isb. 24801. Ikhodi efakiwe iyakhunjulwa.
esim.destinationNamesHint: Umhlinzeki uyibiza ngokuthi "{name}". Shiya ulimi lungenalutho ukuze kuboniswe igama elizenzakalelayo ngompunga: igama lezwe uma kuyizwe elilodwa, elomhlinzeki kwamanye.
esim.mergeHint: Ezindaweni ezimbili eziyindawo eyodwa kodwa abahlinzeki bazinika amagama ahlukene. Ngemva kokuhlanganisa, amaphakheji alendawo, kuhlanganise nalawo azofakwa kamuva, azodayiswa ngaphansi kwendawo oyikhethile, futhi ikheli lalekhasi lizodlulisela lapho. Izindawo zezwe elilodwa zihlanganiswa ngokuzenzakalela.
esim.mergeConfirm: Hlanganisa "{from}" no "{into}"? Umkhiqizo wayo uzoba wusalungiswa futhi ikheli layo lizodlulisela lapho.
esim.unmerged: Ukuhlanganisa kuhlehlisiwe. Umkhiqizo walendawo uhlala ungusalungiswa uze uwubonise futhi.
